events.name: Nanakusa no Sekku (Seven Herbs Festival)
events.visual_hint: Place seven kinds of fresh green leaves beside a small bowl of rice porridge.

events.name: Kagami Biraki (Mirror Opening)
events.visual_hint: Show a small wooden mallet beside pieces of round rice cake on a tray.

events.name: Little New Year
events.visual_hint: Set a small lantern and a gentle winter gathering in a quiet room.

events.name: Hinamatsuri (Doll Festival)
events.visual_hint: Place a tiny tiered display of handmade dolls and peach blossoms in the room.

events.name: Tango no Sekku (Boys' Festival)
events.visual_hint: Hang a small carp streamer outside and add iris leaves nearby.

events.name: Tanabata (Star Festival)
events.visual_hint: Add a leafy bamboo branch with colorful paper strips; shelter it beneath an eave if rain is forecast.

events.name: Choyo no Sekku (Chrysanthemum Festival)
events.visual_hint: Set a few chrysanthemum flowers beside a small cup on a garden table.

events.name: Coffee Day
events.visual_hint: Share a steaming cup of coffee and a few coffee beans at a cozy woodland table.

events.name: New Year's Eve
events.visual_hint: Show a softly lit home at the end of the year with a tidy broom resting by the door.
